scheme_name: Financial Assistance to SC Students Studying in Medical, Engineering and Diploma Course for Purchasing Educational Instrument
other_conditions: Student must belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat
Student must be enrolled in a Medical, Engineering, or Diploma course
benefits_summary: One‑time grant of ₹10,000 for medical students, ₹8,000 for engineering students, and ₹3,000 for diploma students, payable in the first year only.
